win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

wilds.name: SUN RAY FRAMES
wilds.behavior:
A Sun Ray Frame can land on a low-paying, high-paying, or Wild symbol at the start of a spin and will activate after all wins have been handled on that spin. When a Sun Ray Frame activates, it spreads out in straight lines and turns all symbols along the lines into the same symbol type as the symbol the Sun Ray landed on. 

 A Sun Ray Frame can land and spread in two or four directions if there is space, vertically and horizontally, depending on the Sun Ray Frame that lands.

 A vertical Sun Ray Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on upwards and downwards to the edge of the grid.

 A horizontal Sun Ray Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on to the right and left edges of the grid.

 A four-way Sun Ray Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on upward, downward, right, and left to the edge of the grid.

 When the Sun Ray has finished spreading, the wins will be awarded from the new Clusters that are formed. If a Sun Ray Frame spreads over a Wild symbol, an additive 2x Multiplier is added to that Wild symbol. The Multiplier is then added to the Sun Ray win. The Wild Multiplier will increase by 2x every time it is hit by a Sun Ray Frame. If there is more than 1 Wild Multiplier, the Multiplier values will be added and then applied to the entire win. Only 1 Sun Ray Frame can land at the start of a spin.

wilds.name: CHAIN REACTION
wilds.behavior: If a Sun Ray Frame spreads over a low-paying, high-paying, or Wild symbol of the same type as the symbol the Sun Ray landed on, it triggers a Chain Reaction. A Sun Ray Frame will then appear on the second symbol, which triggers another spread depending on the Sun Ray Frame that lands. This Chain Reaction can continue until the grid is full.

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - GOLDEN ECLIPSE
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the SUNFIRE PALACE bonus, with at least 1 Sun Ray Frame guaranteed on every spin!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins.

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 Sun Ray Frames cannot land on FS symbols.
